name: Starter templates
author: Ghost Typist
description: Emails, meetings, support replies, people and engineering notes, with blanks to fill in.

templates.title: Follow up
templates.text:
Hi ${1:name},

Just following up on ${2:our last conversation}. ${3|Any update on your side?,Could you confirm by Friday?,No rush on this.|}

Thanks,
$0

templates.title: Introduce yourself
templates.text:
Hi ${1:name},

I'm ${2:your name} from ${3:company}. ${4:I'd love to find a time to talk.}

Best,
$0

templates.title: Thank you
templates.text: Thank you, ${1:name}, for ${2:your help with this}. I really appreciate it${3|.,!|}

templates.title: Out of office
templates.text: Thanks for your email. I'm out of the office until ${1:date} with limited access to email. For anything urgent, please contact ${2:a colleague}.

templates.title: Politely decline
templates.text: Thanks for thinking of me. Unfortunately I can't take this on right now, but I hope it goes well.

templates.title: Meeting agenda
Meeting notes
Reschedule
templates.text: Hi ${1:name}, could we move ${2:our meeting} to ${3|tomorrow,later this week,next week|}? Happy to work around your schedule.

templates.title: Running late
templates.text: Sorry, I'm running about ${1:5} minutes late and will join as soon as I can.

templates.title: Wrap up
templates.text: Thanks, everyone. I'll send notes and next steps after this.

templates.title: Apologise
templates.text:
Hi ${1:name},

I'm sorry about ${2:the trouble you ran into}. ${3:We're looking into it now} and I'll update you by ${4:tomorrow}.

templates.title: Ask for details
Issue resolved
templates.text: Hi ${1:name}, this is now fixed: ${2:what changed}. Please let me know if you still see ${3|the problem,any errors,anything odd|}.

templates.title: Refund issued
templates.text: Your refund has been issued and should reach your account within 5 to 10 business days.

templates.title: Passed to specialists
templates.text: I've passed this to our specialist team, who will follow up with you directly. You don't need to do anything in the meantime.

templates.title: Interview invite
templates.text:
Hi ${1:name},

Thanks for applying for ${2:the role}. We'd like to invite you to a ${3|30-minute,45-minute,60-minute|} interview. Does ${4:a day and time} work for you?

templates.title: Decline a candidate
templates.text: Hi ${1:name}, thank you for interviewing for ${2:the role}. We've decided to ${3|move forward with another candidate,pause the search|}. We enjoyed meeting you and wish you the best.

templates.title: Give feedback
Welcome to the team
templates.text: Welcome to the team! We're glad you're here. Your first week is about meeting people and getting set up, so ask us anything.

templates.title: Thank a referral
templates.text: Thank you for the referral. We really value it, and we'll keep you posted on how it goes.
